food: I ate a hot dog while rolling past it three times.

object: I found a lone wheel rolling around with no owner.

leaving: I left by crawling to the carpet on my hands and knees.
I left still wobbling, because my legs forgot how floors work.
where: I was glued to the wall, doing the scared crab shuffle.
I was stuck spinning in the center during the limbo contest.
doing: I was doing the hokey pokey and falling on 'turn around.'
I was flapping my arms like a bird to stay upright.

food: I ate a slice of pizza mid-bounce. Most of it landed.

people: I saw a toddler on a plastic penguin pass me with ease.

I was skating like a baby deer in mittens.

I was doing the splits on the wall. Not on purpose.

doing: I was bowling granny-style between my legs.
